_help: Copy to photo_refs.json and fill in. Pixel coords: python tools/sat_grid.py grid <photo> -o previews/g.png --step 50 (or MS Paint bottom bar). Delete parts you do not have.

satellite._corners_order: building outline: front-left, front-right, back-right, back-left (front = street side)
satellite._m_per_px: optional: python tools/sat_grid.py scale --p x,y --q x,y --meters M  (use a known length)

facades.name: front
facades._wall_id: optional: link to manifest.metadata.walls; its length/height/box/normal_deg are then used automatically
facades._yaw_deg: optional explicit camera yaw; normally derived from the linked wall normal
facades._box: optional generator-coordinate render box [x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1]; pivot shift is applied by the checker
facades._size_m: optional real width/height (m) of the wall part inside corners; x_m / z_m = where it lies on the wall
facades._corners_order: that whole wall as seen in the photo: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left (top = roof/parapet top, bottom = ground)
